Name: Eglon, King of Moab
Summary: Eglon, king of Moab, oppressed Israel eighteen years from Jericho until Ehud killed him in his summer parlour.
KeyStory: Eglon, described as a very fat man, received Ehud's 'message from God' alone in his parlour and was killed with a dagger; his servants found him dead after Ehud escaped.
LifeLesson: Power that fattens itself on an oppressed people ends in a locked room.
